conclusion: The simple norm-six golden trace lattice embeds primitively as the full Picard lattice of a projective OG10-type manifold, and the selected trace lift e is a primitive ambient (-6,3) MBM class.

period_projectivity_and_MBM.MBM_input: Mongardi-Onorati, Proposition 3.1 (arXiv:2010.12511): a multiple of a primitive OG10 class of square -6 and divisibility 3 is stably prime-exceptional. Their Proposition 5.4 says the primitive class is a wall divisor; this is the cohomological/MBM wall statement used here.
period_projectivity_and_MBM.full_NS_statement: Period surjectivity for OG10 applied to this primitive embedding realizes N as the full Picard lattice.
period_projectivity_and_MBM.period_complement: T=<2>+<6> is positive definite of rank two
period_projectivity_and_MBM.projectivity_input: A marked OG10 manifold with a positive integral (1,1) class is projective.

scope: This is a positive algebro-geometric carrier and wall theorem. It does not certify a finite Coxeter chamber, compactness, finite volume, or a new hyperbolic Coxeter polytope.

field_reflection.restricted_mirror: On the identity eigenspace, B(e,x)=(-phi/sqrt(5))*H6(e,x), so D^perp restricts to the field mirror e^perp.
